blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Bohol is on the verge of making boxing history. Lawyer and boxing promoter Floriezyl Echavez-Podot of PMI Bohol Boxing Promotions announced that the province is targeting February 2027 for its first world title fight, a milestone made possible by Boholano boxer Regie “The Filipino Phenom” Suganob’s emphatic victory over former two-time world champion Sivenathi Nontshinga. Suganob delivered a sensational fifth-round knockout of Nontshinga in the main event of “Kumong Bol-Anon 26” on Saturday, September 12, at the Bohol Wisdom School in Tagbilaran City. The bout served as an International Boxing Federation (IBF) world light flyweight title eliminator, […]...
